purpose: Track specific sell-side analysts whose PT changes + thesis revisions carry signal weight for this book. Sell-side coverage is usually noise (consensus following price) but a small subset of named analysts drives sector inflections — their out-of-consensus calls move stocks and reset Street thinking. NOT a primary trade driver, but a confirming/disconfirming signal layer in /invest_daily Worker B and /invest:weekly synthesis.

selection_criteria: Analyst's PT revisions historically move the stock >5% on day-of (real price impact)
Coverage overlap with your book's themes (AI-infra, AI-power, semis, memory)
Track record of being early on cycle inflections
Identified by name in industry press (not anonymous house view)

signal_quality_tiering.tier_1: Street-moving — their calls reset consensus; multiple firms follow within 24-48h
signal_quality_tiering.tier_2: Sector specialist — their thesis nuance is high-signal even if PT doesn't move tape
signal_quality_tiering.tier_3: Reference — track for calibration, lower trade weight

caveats: Sell-side PTs are 12-month targets — short-term trades shouldn't anchor to them
Analyst's house view ≠ analyst's actual conviction (look at the note specifics, not the headline)
Big PT revisions often LAG price (analyst forced to catch up) vs LEAD (out-of-consensus call) — distinguish
Conflicts of interest exist (IB relationships, etc.); not all calls are clean research

tracked_analysts.baseline_synthesis: 11 names covered by Arcuri at UBS. **9 Buy / 2 Neutral.** Bullish bias on AI capex beneficiaries (NVDA/AVGO/AMD/ARM/MRVL), WFE supercycle (AMAT/LRCX), memory inflection (MU = Street-high). Cautious on lagging memory exposure (KLAC) and handset/value semis (QCOM/INTC). Implied portfolio framing: long the AI infra winners + WFE + memory; underweight the legacy / handset / non-AI semis.
tracked_analysts.why_track: Made the most aggressive single-revision call on MU in 2026 (PT $535 → $1,625 on 2026-05-26, +204%, Street-high by wide margin). Thesis is structural (LTAs, P/E re-rating to NVDA-multiple, $400B FCF 2027-2029) — if right, it reframes memory as utility-like cash flow rather than commodity cycle. Worth tracking because (a) the call broke a price target ceiling no other firm had touched, and (b) multiple firms followed within hours suggesting institutional respect.

recent_calls_tracked.thesis_summary: Long-term supply agreements (3-5yr) with MSFT Azure / Google Cloud / AWS lock 60-70% of server DDR5 supply. EPS projected >$100 through CY2029. Cumulative FCF $400B+ 2027-2029. Multiple re-rating argument: 'no reason why MU should trade differently than NVDA in terms of P/E.' Structural call, not cyclical.
recent_calls_tracked.calibration_status: OPEN — too early to assess. Will revisit post MU Q3 FY26 print 2026-07-01 AMC. Bull-case validation marker: Q4 guide ≥$36B + HBM4 commentary reassuring. Bear-case marker: Q4 guide soft + HBM4 share concession.

integration_points.invest_daily_worker_b: Each Worker B run scans for PT changes from tracked_analysts.json analysts on held + watchlist names. Flag as '📍 ARCURI PT CHANGE — [ticker] [old PT] → [new PT]' with stock impact + Street follower count. Tier 1 analyst PT changes warrant explicit callout in daily TL;DR.
integration_points.invest_weekly_synthesis: Weekly run: aggregate all tracked-analyst calls in the week. Distinguish 'leading calls' (PT changes ahead of price action) vs 'following calls' (PT chasing existing momentum).
integration_points.calibration_log: Post each material print/event on covered names, log whether tracked-analyst PT/thesis was directionally correct. Build track record over time. Calls that prove correct vs incorrect feed into signal_tier reassessment annually.
integration_points.new_skill_proposal: /invest_analyst [ID] — pulls latest notes from a specific analyst across their coverage, computes hit rate vs subsequent price action.

maintenance_protocol.add_analyst_criteria: Only add when an analyst meets selection_criteria (especially: PT revisions move stocks >5% day-of). Default is to NOT add — quality > quantity. Currently 1 tracked.
maintenance_protocol.remove_analyst_criteria: Remove if (a) leaves coverage, (b) their out-of-consensus calls stop landing, (c) firm reorganizes coverage. Don't remove on a single bad call — calibrate over 4+ quarters.
maintenance_protocol.review_cadence: Quarterly review of tracked analysts' call quality vs subsequent price action. Annual review of full universe vs candidates.
